# Source-qualified fact catalog

These records support reference reading; they do not validate an equipment configuration or describe the state of a connected radio.

The {download}`canonical JSON <../knowledge/catalog.json>` and {download}`JSON Schema <../knowledge/catalog.schema.json>` are available for inspection and reuse. Numeric ranges retain their source scope and conditions. Empty scope lists mean **not asserted**, rather than all revisions or all software. Reviews here are source checks; their method is shown and does not imply independent human review or hardware measurements.

(fact-micro.bandwidth.base)=
## Declared base-mode bandwidth range

The shared micro definitions declare an analog bandwidth control range.

**Value:** 200,000 to 56,000,000 Hz. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode base.

**Conditions:**

- Applies as an implementation reference in base mode.
- The pinned setter warns about bandwidth assignments in oversample mode; do not extend this claim to that mode.

**Evidence:**

- [Micro shared range and clock definitions](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/fpga_common/include/bladerf2_common.h#L540-L547>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol bladerf2\_bandwidth\_range.
- [Micro board and clock-control implementation](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/host/libraries/libbladeRF/src/board/bladerf2/bladerf2.c#L1210-L1230>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol bladerf2\_set\_bandwidth.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.bandwidth.base`.

(fact-micro.bias.rx-shared)=
## Receive bias control is shared by direction

A channel argument does not establish independently switched receive bias power.

**Value:** RX1 and RX2. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB 1.4, 1.6; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode not\_asserted.

**Conditions:**

- The implementation selects one RX enable bit for either receive channel.
- This record describes control sharing; it does not specify available accessory current.

**Evidence:**

- [Micro board and clock-control implementation](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/host/libraries/libbladeRF/src/board/bladerf2/bladerf2.c#L3022-L3050>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol bladerf\_set\_bias\_tee.
- [bladeRF 2.0 micro schematics REV 1.4](<https://www.nuand.com/bladeRF-2.0-micro-REV1.4.pdf#page=2>) — REV 1.4, physical PDF page 2, printed label 2.
- [bladeRF 2.0 micro schematics REV 1.6](<https://www.nuand.com/bladeRF-2.0-micro-REV1.6.pdf#page=2>) — REV 1.6, physical PDF page 2, printed label 2.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.bias.rx-shared`.

(fact-micro.clock.onboard-frequency)=

The onboard VCTCXO reference is nominally 38.4 MHz.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB 1.4, 1.6; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode not\_asserted.

**Conditions:**

**Evidence:**

- [Micro shared range and clock definitions](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/fpga_common/include/bladerf2_common.h#L43-L54>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol BLADERF\_VCTCXO\_FREQUENCY.
- [bladeRF 2.0 micro schematics REV 1.4](<https://www.nuand.com/bladeRF-2.0-micro-REV1.4.pdf#page=13>) — REV 1.4, physical PDF page 13, printed label 13.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.clock.onboard-frequency`.

(fact-micro.clock.pll-dac-exclusion)=
## PLL and trim DAC control exclusion

Enabling the onboard reference PLL disables the trim DAC, and vice versa.

**Value:** true. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode not\_asserted.

**Conditions:**

- Describes control of the onboard VCTCXO.
- Selecting an external clock input is a separate operation; this does not establish discipline of that external generator.

**Evidence:**

- [Micro-specific public API contracts](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/host/libraries/libbladeRF/include/bladeRF2.h#L285-L297>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol bladerf\_set\_pll\_enable.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.clock.pll-dac-exclusion`.

(fact-micro.clock.refin-range)=
## Declared external PLL reference range

The micro implementation declares a PLL reference-input frequency range.

**Value:** 5,000,000 to 300,000,000 Hz. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode external\_reference.

**Conditions:**

- This is the range accepted by the pinned implementation, not a guarantee of all divider/waveform/lock combinations.
- The REFIN input and direct CLKIN path have different roles.

**Evidence:**

- [Micro board and clock-control implementation](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/host/libraries/libbladeRF/src/board/bladerf2/bladerf2.c#L78-L85>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol bladerf2\_pll\_refclk\_range.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.clock.refin-range`.

(fact-micro.rx.shared-lo)=
## Receive channels share a local oscillator

The two receive channels share the receive local oscillator.

**Value:** true. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode not\_asserted.

**Conditions:**

- Two receive paths do not provide independent simultaneous analog center frequencies.
- The transmit direction has a separate RF synthesizer.

**Evidence:**

- [AD9361 host-control implementation](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/host/libraries/libbladeRF/src/board/bladerf2/rfic_host.c#L474-L500>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol \_rfic\_host\_select\_band.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.rx.shared-lo`.

(fact-micro.sample-rate.base)=
## Base-mode sample-rate range

The normal feature mode selects the base sample-rate range.

**Value:** 520,834 to 61,440,000 samples/s. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode base.

**Conditions:**

- This is the range declared by the pinned micro implementation, not a guarantee of RF performance or sustained host throughput.
- Low rates can require RFIC interpolation/decimation filters; use actual readbacks.

**Evidence:**

- [Micro shared range and clock definitions](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/fpga_common/include/bladerf2_common.h#L517-L524>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol bladerf2\_sample\_rate\_range\_base.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.sample-rate.base`.

(fact-micro.sample-rate.oversample)=

The oversample feature selects a different rate range.

**Value:** 6,250,000 to 122,880,000 samples/s. **Evidence kind:** `pinned_implementation`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode oversample.

**Conditions:**

- This is the range declared by the pinned micro implementation, not a guarantee of RF performance or sustained host throughput.
- Requires the oversample feature and compatible gateware/format configuration; this is not the ordinary mode or a sustained-streaming measurement.

**Evidence:**

(fact-micro.sc16.host-bytes)=
## SC16 Q11 host sample size

One single-channel complex host sample occupies four bytes.

**Value:** 4 bytes. **Evidence kind:** `derived`.

**Scope:** bladeRF 2.0 micro; FPGA xA9; PCB not asserted; software libbladeRF 2.6.0; mode not\_asserted.

**Conditions:**

- Single channel, I then Q, two signed 16-bit components.
- Excludes file headers and metadata; do not infer wire packing or multi-channel API count conventions.

**Derivation:** 2 components per complex sample multiplied by 2 bytes per component equals 4 bytes.

**Evidence:**

- [libbladeRF sample representation and API contracts](<https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF/blob/fcf9423325ae49f5fdd2e5b52ab68bfc2576ad47/host/libraries/libbladeRF/include/libbladeRF.h#L2085-L2142>) — 2025.10 / libbladeRF 2.6.0, symbol BLADERF\_FORMAT\_SC16\_Q11.

**Review:** `source_checked`; method `agent_assisted`. Record `micro.sc16.host-bytes`.

## Issues and coverage gaps

These records retain source disagreements and unresolved coverage. They are not automatically resolved by schema validation.

### FAQ and schematic clock-output designators differ

The FAQ calls CLKOUT U92, while both inspected schematics designate its connector J92.

Status `open`; kind `source_disagreement`; issue `clock-output-designator`.

**Current interpretation:** Use the revision-qualified schematic designator J92 for this connector; retain the FAQ mismatch rather than silently merging the names.

Related claims: {ref}`fact-micro.connector.j92.label`.

### Streaming alignment descriptions need a source-specific resolution

The pinned synchronous tutorial, public header, and format-specific implementation express alignment differently. Do not turn one tutorial multiple into an unconditional setting rule.

Status `open`; kind `source_disagreement`; issue `packed-alignment-documentation`.
